title: DevExp bootcamp sync — SDK + samples sprint
summary: Weekly sync for the new-hire bootcamp cohort focused on SDK exercises, sample apps, and quickstart docs. Recorded progress, blockers, and action items for next week.
body:
Attendees: Priya, Jordan, Mateo, Sofia, Liam (10/03/2026)

Purpose: quick weekly checkpoint for the DevExp bootcamp cohort (week 2). Focus areas: SDK labs, sample app templates, quickstart narrative, and CI runner flakiness.

Notes (freeform):
- Quick wins: sample repo 'starter-chat-app' now has a working TypeScript and Python sample that both pass local smoke tests. Jordan landed fix for async streaming edge-case (GH PR 5421).
- Docs: quickstart draft still reads too prescriptive — Mateo will rework the flow to show two parallel paths (hosted API vs private). Need clearer TL;DR table for tradeoffs (latency/cost/when to use Dedicated).
- Labs/Exercises: cohort 1 reported the SDK auth section was confusing (token vs key rotation). Added a short 'auth primer' to the exercises; Sofia to author one-pager with examples.
- CI: flakiness on CI integration test that spins up the mock runtime — failing intermittently on macOS runners. Liam triaged logs; suspects ephemeral port collisions. Action: add randomized ports + retry logic.
- Observability sample: introduced a small trace example showing token-level cost breakdown; looks promising but needs polishing before including in quickstart.
- Onboarding flow: students expect a single canonical 'first-step' repo. We should pick one sample to be the canonical guided path (starter-chat-app) and make others labeled as 'advanced'.
- Timeboxing: agreed to aim for a polished quickstart (canonical path + 3-minute video) by end of next sprint (10/17).

Blockers & open questions:
- Legal review pending for the included embedding dataset in samples (privacy questions). Waiting on legal sign-off (ticket: JIRA-PRIV-78).
- Need a small, reproducible offline example for Private deployments (VPC mode) — current infra for bootcamp is hosted-only. Who can help stand up a minimal VPC demo? (ask infra on-call).
- QA capacity limited next week; if we want cross-browser checks for the sample UI we must cut scope or delay nonblocking polish items.

Decisions made:
- Keep starter-chat-app as canonical. Tag all other samples as 'advanced' with a clear 'prereqs' section.
- Move the streaming edge-case fix to a small patch release for the SDK (v0.12.1) rather than bundling with larger changes.

Action items (owners / due dates):
- Jordan: merge GH-PR-5421 after one more smoke test; prepare release notes snippet for v0.12.1 (due 2026-10-06).
- Mateo: rewrite quickstart path + create TL;DR tradeoffs table (due 2026-10-10).
- Sofia: draft 'SDK auth primer' one-pager and example snippets for token rotation (due 2026-10-08).
- Liam: add randomized ports + simple retry wrapper to CI mock runtime, re-run failing matrix (due 2026-10-07).
- Priya: coordinate with Legal on JIRA-PRIV-78 and report back with redlines (due 2026-10-09).
- All: add small checklist item to sample READMEs: 'How to test locally' + common failure troubleshooting (short bullets).

Follow-ups for next sync:
- Demo canonical quickstart flow (live walkthrough) — Mateo will present.
- Brief on CI stability improvements and metrics (Liam).
- Status on legal review and whether we need to swap dataset (Priya).
- Review of the 3-minute explainer video storyboard — volunteers: Jordan + Sofia.

Retrospective notes / quick observations:
- Bootcamp cohort user feedback pipeline is working — survey responses are actionable and concise. Keep the surveys light (3 Qs) and add a freeform 'pain point' field.
- We should capture one 'failure log' example in the samples repo that shows a common error and the exact steps to debug it — high value for onboarding.

Loose ideas (brainstormed):
- Small 'choose your path' CLI tool that scaffolds the canonical sample with flags (hosted vs private, language). Could be a tiny go/rust shim or node script; low priority but high perceived polish.
- Short gif gallery in README that shows the sample app in <10s clips — aids quick comprehension.

Misc notes to self:
- Link to Confluence bootcamp page in README once final version of quickstart is up.
- Archive cohort-specific feedback in a Google Sheet for easy sorting by pain area.

Next meeting: 2026-10-10, 10:00am PT (short standup + demo).

Raw scratch items (todo scribbles):
- add more unit tests for SDK streaming client
- collect macOS CI logs and attach to PR
- re-label sample branches: canonical/advanced
- check legal copy for dataset usage

End of notes.
